title: Robotics: Capture a Free-Floating Cargo Module

steps.hint: Select the CHECKLIST tab on the CAMERA display to your right. Capture is always flown from the checklist.
ARM POWER is the far-left toggle on the ARM CONTROL panel ahead of you. Check its label shows ON; the arm cannot move unpowered.
CAMERA 2 is on the CAMERA display to your right. Check the view shows the cargo module grapple fixture, the handle the arm grips.
The SHOULDER dial is on the ARM CONTROL panel. Check it points at TARGET; large joints move first, then small ones.
WRIST is the dial right of SHOULDER. Check it points at TARGET; the wrist lines the arm's gripper up with the fixture.
CAPTURE is the left lever on the END EFFECTOR panel to your left. RELEASE sits beside it; pulling it lets the module go.
BRAKES ON is bottom-left on the ARM CONTROL panel. Brakes hold the arm still after capture, so the module cannot drift.
REPORT is bottom-right on the ARM CONTROL panel. Press it only once the module is captured and braked; mission control relies on it.
